description: Permanent acceptance contract for append-only steward assessment, honest learning metrics, exact-scope batch operations, and version-locked document-patch proposals.

cases.description: A later steward assessment appends history rather than overwriting an earlier decision.
Only the latest assessment per candidate contributes to current KPI denominators.
Unknown assessment verdicts and oversized notes are rejected.
A reviewer cannot assess a candidate outside their exact organization and department scope.
Strict precision is correct divided by adjudicated latest assessments and is null without a denominator.
Actionable yield is correct plus partially correct divided by all latest assessed candidates.
Insufficient-evidence assessments count as reviewed but not as adjudicated precision outcomes.
A batch cannot be created without at least one available candidate.
A batch contains at most 25 unique candidates.
Every batch candidate shares the same organization, project, and department scope.
A batch assignee must be an active steward authorized for the batch scope.
A failed candidate validation rolls back the batch, memberships, and candidate transitions.
Concurrent batching attempts converge without placing a candidate in conflicting active batches.
Dismissing a batch returns still-batched candidates to the governed review queue.
Batch creation and lifecycle actions cannot create proposals, claims, documents, or document versions.
Shadow mode cannot promote a document-patch candidate into a governed proposal.
A patch targets only the candidate document in the candidate's exact persisted scope.
A patch requires persisted Context Receipt evidence for the exact target document version.
A detected document-patch candidate persists its bounded automation kind and evidence base version.
A patch contains between one and ten bounded exact replacements.
Every find value must occur exactly once in the sequential base document.
An empty or no-op replacement cannot create a proposal.
The database reconstructs proposed content from the current immutable version and exact replacements.
Patch promotion creates one pending knowledge proposal and does not mutate a document or version.
A changed target version rejects patch promotion or approval without partial writes.
Authenticated clients cannot execute M6.3 mutation RPCs directly.
Assessment, batch, and patch-proposal transitions persist bounded audit events.
